today_in_history_posts.title: Suggestion for a universal bitcoin value scale
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Martin Damgaard suggests a universal bitcoin value color scale to the bitcoin-dev list.
- His proposal aims to address the decimal issue from BIP 176 by Jimmy Song.
- He has provided his suggestion in rtf, pdf, and docx formats for easy review.

today_in_history_posts.title: Measuring Lightning Nodes
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Swayam seeks to measure the lightning network topology.
- Artem clarifies measurement needs; connection and init message setup required for details.
- Alternatively, Swayam can use explorer sites or lightning-cli commands for info.

today_in_history_posts.title: Deflationary money is a Good Thing
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Investment strategies are divided into passive and active types.  - Passive investment often leads to the misalignment of asset owner's and agent's interests.  - Central banks might stabilize economies by backing inflationary currencies with deflationary ones like Bitcoin.
